ready_state: Electric scooter mounted, stationary, menu closed; ordinary evening/turbo/free-roam settings preserved.
actual_UI_steps: Escape menu; electric scooter station shortcut; physical OS E shows scooter riding caption/standing avatar.
OS W held 2200ms moves scooter away from dock; OS Space held 1000ms stops it.
OS E dismounts; bicycle station shortcut; OS E shows bicycle riding caption.
OS E bicycle return; scooter shortcut; OS E mounts scooter again. Left open for user.
manual_scope: Short CUA native keyboard smoke on this Mac, not a claim of all-user subjective comfort, all contacts, long duration or maximum speed measured via OS. Automated physical KEY_E events and synthetic movement suites are listed separately.
